title: Paracetamol under a streetlight
situation: Heat, humidity and overcrowding; volunteer doctors (4-5 at any time) hand out ORS and paracetamol to 200+ people; protesters not eating get nausea and dehydration.

lines.text: food and ORS are being provided to such individuals at the protest site
lines.speaker: doctors

buildThis.situation: Sana's table: deliver ORS to the person swaying in the sun before 13:00 and the faint-and-ambulance beat does not happen near your crew.
